run_train_cifar10_model: run the CIFAR-10 CNN training script on TPU with configurable epochs and learning rate
build_cnn_model_cifar10: build a sequential CNN model with Conv2D, MaxPooling2D, Flatten, and Dense layers for CIFAR-10 classification
configure_tpu_strategy: configure a TPUStrategy with TPUClusterResolver for distributed training on TPU
load_and_normalize_cifar10: load the CIFAR-10 dataset and normalize pixel values to the range 0 to 1
train_model_with_tensorboard: train the compiled model with TensorBoard callback for logging training metrics and histograms
